diagrams.title: **The journey in this section
diagrams.caption: **The journey in this section.** We start with why teams help, build four team shapes in four notebooks, and finish with the most important skill: knowing when you don't need a team at all.

diagrams.title: **One generalist vs a team of specialists
diagrams.caption: **One generalist vs a team of specialists.** The coordinator breaks the request into subtasks and delegates; each specialist does one job well and reports back.

diagrams.title: **Four questions behind every pattern
diagrams.caption: **Four questions behind every pattern.** Orchestration, specialisation, collaboration and coordination. Each pattern in this section is a different set of answers to them.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 400" aria-label="Four fundamental aspects of a multi-agent system. Orchestration: how information flows, through a central coordinator like a conductor or directly between agents like a jazz group. Specialisation: each agent has a focused role and tools. Collaboration: how agents share and build on each other's work. Coordination: a defined workflow like a classical score, or agents deciding as they go like jazz improvisation." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah-proto" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-proto" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
      <rect x="20" y="20" width="520" height="170" rx="18" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="44" y="58" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">1 Orchestration</text>
      <text x="44" y="94" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">How does information flow between agents?</text>
      <circle cx="80" cy="140" r="14" class="fill-proto" style="fill:#6C43CC"></circle><path d="M94 140 H140" class="ln-proto" marker-end="url(#ah-proto)" style="stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path><circle cx="160" cy="124" r="10" class="fill-ink" style="fill:#3A4266"></circle><circle cx="160" cy="156" r="10" class="fill-ink" style="fill:#3A4266"></circle><path d="M90 130 L148 124 M90 150 L148 156" class="ln-proto" style="stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
      <text x="190" y="146" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">central conductor</text>
      <circle cx="350" cy="124" r="10" class="fill-ink" style="fill:#3A4266"></circle><circle cx="400" cy="156" r="10" class="fill-ink" style="fill:#3A4266"></circle><circle cx="450" cy="124" r="10" class="fill-ink" style="fill:#3A4266"></circle><path d="M360 128 L392 150 M408 150 L442 128 M360 124 H440" class="ln" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
      <text x="338" y="180" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">agents talk directly</text>
      <rect x="560" y="20" width="520" height="170" rx="18" class="tool" style="fill:#D6F2EE;stroke:#0B7F73;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="584" y="58" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">2 Specialisation</text>
      <text x="584" y="94" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">Each agent gets a focused role, expertise and tools.</text>
      <text x="584" y="130" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">A research agent shouldn't also do data</text>
      <text x="584" y="154" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">visualisation. Let specialists specialise.</text>
      <rect x="20" y="210" width="520" height="170" rx="18" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="44" y="248" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">3 Collaboration</text>
      <text x="44" y="284" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">How do agents share and build on each other's work?</text>
      <rect x="44" y="306" width="150" height="46" rx="10" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="119" y="335" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:14px">research agent</text>
      <path d="M194 329 H250" class="ln-data" marker-end="url(#ah-data)" style="stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path><text x="222" y="318" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">output</text>
      <rect x="254" y="306" width="150" height="46" rx="10" class="agent" style="fill:#19203F;stroke:#19203F;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="329" y="335" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#F2F4F8;font-size:14px">analysis agent</text>
      <text x="420" y="335" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">becomes input</text>
      <rect x="560" y="210" width="520" height="170" rx="18" class="brain" style="fill:#FFF1CC;stroke:#B07600;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
      <text x="584" y="248" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">4 Coordination</text>
      <text x="584" y="284" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">Who decides the order of work?</text>
      <text x="584" y="322" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• A workflow you define (a classical score)</text>
      <text x="584" y="350" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• Agents decide as they go (jazz improvisation)</text>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **All communication goes through the supervisor
diagrams.caption: **All communication goes through the supervisor.** Workers do specialised tasks and report back; they never talk to each other (the red ✕s). Each worker gets a question rephrased for its speciality.
diagrams.svg:

diagrams.title: **Three costs of having one boss
diagrams.caption: **Three costs of having one boss.** Each has well-known fixes, which is why the pattern still dominates in production.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 330" aria-label="Three trade-offs of the supervisor-worker pattern and their fixes. Bottleneck: every request queues at one supervisor; fix with horizontal scaling, caching, prompt caching, load balancing and async processing. Single point of failure: if the supervisor crashes the system stops; fix with health checks, automatic restarts, checkpoints and redundant supervisors with failover. Workers can't talk directly: everything routes via the supervisor; fine for simple workflows, use collaborative patterns for negotiations." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-proto" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-proto" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>
        <g>
          <rect x="20" y="20" width="340" height="290" rx="18" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
          <text x="40" y="56" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">1 Bottleneck</text>
          <g class="fill-user" style="fill:#4A5170"><rect x="40" y="82" width="22" height="22" rx="4"></rect><rect x="68" y="82" width="22" height="22" rx="4"></rect><rect x="96" y="82" width="22" height="22" rx="4"></rect><rect x="124" y="82" width="22" height="22" rx="4"></rect><rect x="152" y="82" width="22" height="22" rx="4"></rect></g>
          <path d="M180 93 H214" class="ln" marker-end="url(#ah)" style="stroke:#3A4266;stroke-width:2.5;fill:none"></path>
          <rect x="218" y="74" width="120" height="40" rx="10" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="278" y="99" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">supervisor</text>
          <text x="40" y="146" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">every decision goes through one agent</text>
          <text x="40" y="186" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Fixes</text>
          <text x="40" y="214" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• more supervisor copies (scale out)</text><text x="40" y="240" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• cache repeat answers, prompt caching</text><text x="40" y="266" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• load balancing, async processing</text>
        </g>
        <g>
          <rect x="380" y="20" width="340" height="290" rx="18" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect>
          <text x="400" y="56" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">2 Single point of failure</text>
          <rect x="400" y="74" width="120" height="40" rx="10" class="risk" style="fill:#FBE3E8;stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="460" y="99" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:14px">supervisor ✕</text>
          <path d="M520 94 H560" class="ln-risk dash" style="stroke:#C4344F;stroke-width:3;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:7 7"></path><rect x="564" y="74" width="136" height="40" rx="10" class="bx" style="fill:#FFFFFF;stroke:#D7DCE8;stroke-width:2;opacity:.5"></rect><text x="632" y="99" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">workers idle</text>
          <text x="400" y="146" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">if it crashes, the whole system stops</text>
          <text x="400" y="186" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">Fixes</text>
          <text x="400" y="214" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• health checks, automatic restarts</text><text x="400" y="240" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• checkpoints to resume from last state</text><text x="400" y="266" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• redundant supervisors with failover</text>
        </g>

          <path d="M850 100 Q910 140 966 100" class="ln-proto dash" marker-end="url(#ah-proto)" style="stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:3;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:7 7"></path><text x="910" y="146" text-anchor="middle" class="tx" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:14px">via supervisor</text>
          <text x="760" y="186" class="lab ink-tool" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#075A51;font-size:15px;font-weight:700">When it matters</text>
          <text x="760" y="214" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• fine for simple workflows</text><text x="760" y="240" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">• negotiations need collaborative</text><text x="760" y="266" class="tm" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#3A4266;font-size:16px">  communication (4.6)</text>
